bullets.text: Cloud-Based Ransomware Threat - **Storm-0501** is evolving to exploit cloud environments for ransomware attacks, shifting from traditional methods.
Market Leader in Security - **Microsoft Defender** retains its top position in modern endpoint security market share for the third consecutive year.
Gears of War Returns - **Gears of War: Reloaded** is now available on multiple platforms, celebrating its legacy.
Securing Autonomous Agents - **Microsoft** emphasizes the need for governance as autonomous agents proliferate in enterprise environments.
Azure Security Initiatives - **Microsoft** is enhancing security across Azure infrastructure from silicon to systems.
Windows 11 Insider Updates - New features in **Windows 11** Insider Preview builds enhance cross-device app usage.
Faster Game Access - **Xbox Insiders** can now use the new 'My Apps' feature for quicker game access on Windows 11.
Open Source Evolution - **Microsoft** has transformed into a leading contributor in the open-source community, enhancing its platforms.
Gartner Recognition - **Microsoft** is named a Leader in the 2025 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Cloud-Native Application Platforms.
ClickFix Social Engineering - **Microsoft** warns about the rising ClickFix technique used in social engineering attacks.
